eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following areas: Jefferson Davis, LA; at 6:20 AM on SEP 18, 2026 Effective until 7:20 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: There has been a gas pipeline rupture on farm supply north of highway 90 AVOID THE AREA OF HIGHWAY 90 BETWEEN MONGER ROAD AND 395. THERE HAS BEEN A PIPELINE RUPTURE EMERGENCY PERSONEL ARE WORKING TO EVACUATE AND CLEAR THE AREA. HIGHWAY 90 IS CLOSED BETWEEN MONGER ROAD AND 395
